villa_snapshot: Villa snapshot
Tucked within a serene, gated hillside enclave, this luxe 4-BHK cottage is designed for those who find joy in quiet luxury and thoughtful details!

Surrounded by pine-covered slopes and panoramic valley vistas, it blends Alpine-inspired architecture with natural stone elements that mirror the landscape. Cobbled pathways, bordered by manicured planters lead to the entrance, softly lit by old-world street lamps that set a calming tone.

Stepping indoors, the living room is anchored by a brown, tufted leather chesterfield sofa and teal wingback armchairs, radiating understated elegance. A statement crystal chandelier glimmers overhead, along with stylish decor and large windows.

The adjacent dining area features a tufted teal bench on one side of the table, paired with four floral-patterned high-back chairs on the other. The modern kitchen is outfitted with high-gloss taupe cabinetry, premium finishes, and state-of-the-art appliances.

The charming lounge area on the first floor boasts an L-shaped sofa and a uniquely shaped wooden coffee table, blending comfort with modern design. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame sweeping views from every bedroom, while the master bedroom on the first floor opens to a private balcony.

Beneath a sloped ceiling with exposed wooden beams, the indoor bar area is ideal for leisurely evenings. It features a dark wood counter, two cushioned black stools, a vibrant sofa and air conditioning for added comfort. Just beyond, the spacious terrace opens up to breathtaking 360° views of the surrounding hills, framed by a border of colourful flowers.
A premium clubhouse for peaceful escapes and memorable evenings, with a serene pool, elegant bar, and more for refined indulgence.

To elevate this experience, a dedicated 5-star hospitality team is always on hand, ready to assist with a warm smile and genuine care, embodying the true essence of "Atithi Devo Bhava." From a butler and chef-on-call to a premium welcome basket and a thoughtful farewell gift, every detail is arranged to make guests feel cared for and pampered!
